title: Show a live thin-turn conversation from the CLI
description:
Purpose: let a person see the live thin turn without reading exercise_thin_turn.py exit codes.

exercise_thin_turn.py is an acceptance harness. It prints claim_a=200 and bots_list=1. It is not a demo. The product surface is still the web app (Vultus), which is not Phase 1. Until that exists, a CLI is how a human addresses a named bot and watches one durable streamed answer.

Definition of Done:
- A documented command talks to a named cloud environment (development first).
- The person types a message, sees tokens as they arrive, and sees the committed reply.
- Reconnect after a drop still shows the same turn from stored chunks.
- Auth is the existing invoke key plus tenant, not product login.
- exercise_thin_turn.py stays the pass/fail gate; this CLI does not replace it.

Not included: chattic.us, Vultus, product login, computer, browser, approvals.

comments.text: Not starting the demo CLI here. exercise_thin_turn.py stays the pass/fail gate. Next HTTP that helps a CLI reconnect: GET /users/{user_id}/turns (list in-flight turns after Front Door recycle).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
## HTTP now live that a demo CLI can use (not the CLI itself)

`GET /users/{user_id}/turns` is on development ThinTurn @ `95964f7` (`turns_list=1`). It walks durable per-channel `active_turn` pointers. Completed turns are omitted. A recycled Front Door can answer it with no process memory.

That is the reconnect roster this epic needs. Pair it with the rest of the household-recovery surface already on **development** (ahead of `main` v0.6.0):

| Need | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Named bot after recycle | `GET /bots?user_id=&name=` or `GET /users/{user_id}/bots` |
| Channels after recycle | `GET /users/{user_id}/channels` |
| In-flight turns after recycle | `GET /users/{user_id}/turns` |
| One channel's active turn (404 if none) | `GET /channels/{id}/turn` |
| Post and start a turn | `POST /channels/{id}/messages` (`Idempotency-Key`) |
| Watch tokens | `GET /turns/{id}/stream` (`Last-Event-ID`) |
| Journal after a drop | `GET /turns/{id}/events?after=` |
| Channel history after a drop | `GET /channels/{id}/messages?after=` |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant CLI
  participant FD as Front Door
  CLI->>FD: GET /users/{user_id}/turns
  FD-->>CLI: in-flight turn_ids
  CLI->>FD: GET /turns/{id}/stream Last-Event-ID
  FD-->>CLI: turn.token then turn.completed
```

Target **development** (`https://d3gpuuldffe35o.cloudfront.net`). `main` v0.6.0 has bot list, not this turns list. Auth is still invoke key plus `X-Tenant-Id`. `exercise_thin_turn.py` stays the pass/fail gate; this epic should not reimplement claim/fence checks.

Still out of scope here: computer, browser, approvals, Vultus.
